violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. Food items found on the floor of the walk-in freezer and next to the beverage dispenser near the drive up window. Food items should be stored at least 6 inches off of the floor.
Toilet facilities. — --Toilet room was not clean or kept in good repair. Ventilation fan in the women's restroom was found dirty. This should be cleaned and maintained clean.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floor in the sandwich preparation area was found dirty. Floors should be cleaned and maintained clean.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface of clean in place equipment was not cleaned properly. Shelving units in the walk-in cooler were found dirty during inspection. These should be cleaned and maintained clean.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. Single use items were found stored on the floor near the ice machine. Single use items should be stored off of the floor.

Employee dressing areas and lockers. — --Employees' clothing/possessions were in an area where contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items may occur. Employee beverages were found stored on tables in the front food preparation area. Personal items should be stored separated from food items used in the facility.
